raw.description: 1-to-5 rating scale with 0.25 increments, where a higher score indicates greater expertise. Descriptions range from 1.0 ('Not qualified to review') to 5.0 ('Background to assess all aspects').

soft.description: Soft binary labels: scores >= 3.0 are mapped to 1 (relevant), scores < 3.0 are mapped to 0 (irrelevant).

hard.description: Hard binary labels: scores >= 4.0 are mapped to 1 (relevant), scores < 4.0 are mapped to 0 (irrelevant).
